shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- routing ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- deps ---\\n' && for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; do node -p \"require('./'+process.argv[1]).version + ' ' + process.argv[1]\" \""'$p"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit -maxdepth 3 \\( -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -iname 'README.md' \\) -print"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json | tail -n 80 && npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8 version peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@''^8.12.0 && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit -maxdepth 4 '"\\( -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -iname 'README.md' \\) -print && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/dist -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && printf '\\n--- README setup ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md && printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n' && rg -n \"ChartKit|lazy|YagrChart|GravityCharts\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 6 \"YagrPlugin|type=\\\"yagr\\\"|YagrWidgetData|import .*chartkit/yagr\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -180 && printf '\\n--- package deps ---\\n' && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json'); console.log(p.version,p.dependencies,p.peerDependencies)\""

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- gc data ---\\n'; rg -n \"export type ChartData|interface ChartData|type ChartData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; printf '\\n--- yagr cfg ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- ui controls dts ---\\n'; rg -n \"export declare const SegmentedRadioGroup|export declare const RadioGroup|export declare const Switch\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; sed -n '3300,3375p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts; rg -n \"interface LineSeries|type LineSeries|interface Series|type Series\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '3370,3415p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts; sed -n '1695,1825p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts; rg -n \"interface ControlGroupProps|interface ControlProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types* -g '*'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"interface RawSerieData|type RawSerieData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -g '*.d.ts' | head -10; rg -n -A 35 \"interface RawSerieData|type RawSerieData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -70; rg -n -A 30 \"interface ChartXAxis|type ChartXAxis\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts | head -65; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n -B 8 -A 30 "export interface ExtendedSeriesOptions" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -65; rg -n -B 3 -A 20 "interface ChartAxis" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/config/chart-config.d.ts | head -50'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n -B 4 -A 35 "export type DataSeriesExtended|type DataSeriesExtended|export interface LineSeriesOptions" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -120'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "command -v apply_patch || type -a apply_patch || ls /usr/local/bin | rg 'patch|apply'"
/bin/bash -lc 'find / -name apply_patch -type f -perm -111 2>/dev/null | head -5'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/VisualizationWidget.tsx')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace(\"import type {ChartData} from '@gravity-ui/charts';\\nimport type {YagrWidgetData} from '@gravity-ui/chartkit/yagr';\", \"import type {GravityChartsWidgetData} from '@gravity-ui/chartkit/gravity-charts';\\nimport type {YagrWidgetData} from '@gravity-ui/chartkit/yagr';\")
text = text.replace('    sales: ChartData;', '    sales: GravityChartsWidgetData;')
path.write_text(text)
PY
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/VisualizationWidget.tsx
@@
-    sales: GravityChartsWidgetData;
+    sales: GravityChartsWidgetData['data'];
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/App.tsx
@@
-import {VisualizationWidget, type VisualizationMode} from './VisualizationWidget';
+import {
+    VisualizationWidget,
+    type VisualizationMode,
+    type VisualizationWidgetData,
+} from './VisualizationWidget';
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- package.json package-lock.json src/App.tsx src/VisualizationWidget.tsx | sed -n '1,260p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' src/VisualizationWidget.tsx; npm exec prettier -- --check src/VisualizationWidget.tsx src/App.tsx 2>/dev/null || true; ls -l package-lock.json | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type TextVariant|TextVariant =\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text -g '*.d.ts' | head -20 && rg -n -A 12 \"type TextVariant\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"variant\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/VisualizationWidget.tsx
@@
 settings.set({plugins: [GravityChartsPlugin, YagrPlugin]});
 
 const modes = [
-    {value: 'sales', content: 'Продажи'},
-    {value: 'monitoring', content: 'Мониторинг'},
+    {content: 'Продажи', value: 'sales'},
+    {content: 'Мониторинг', value: 'monitoring'},
 ] as const;
*** End Patch
PATCH
git diff --check && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/VisualizationWidget.tsx | sed -n '1,70p'; printf '\\n---\\n'; nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'"
